title: Sajjad Diyan Akhiyan Rondiyan
body:
Sajjad Diyan Akhiyan Rondiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Enu Darbaar Diyan X2
Payshian Maar Gaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Chadraan Mangda Reya Veeran Tay Babe Day Qatilan Toh Ro Ro
Aye Jad Beer De Vich X2
Bay Rida Aun Di Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Kisay Sadqa Suteya Kisay Baghi Kehkay Enu Pathar Maray
Sakhtiyan Kee Kee Na X2
Haye Beemar Sayan
<<DIVIDER>>
Lut Gaya Aal-e-Nabi Da Gharana Sara Vich Pardesan Day
Bach Gaya Deen Magar X2
Tera Ay Rab-e-Jahan
<<DIVIDER>>
Tauk Zanjeer Nahi Laash Islam Di Si Jeri Chuk Layee Abid
Eho Ro Ro Nadir X2
Kehn Kariyaan Day Nishaan
